reference.operation: BorderBeam has no own component defaults. Raw alias CSS declarations and root/pseudo padding, gradient, size, mask/path and animation timing across algorithms, zero/undefined, named cssVar, explicit props, context/local style priorities, nested/reset/sibling scopes and multiple layers. External target is returned by a standard React forwardRef/useImperativeHandle child; it carries conflicting inherited variables. Owner context must win on the portal layer. Animated offset-distance/time and source keyframe hashes are intentionally not comparison fields.
